pages.title: Block of Dilithium
pages.text: Dilithium crystals fused into one solid block that rings when struck and glows a soft violet. The resonance carries through the floor, and anything metal nearby picks up a faint hum. In a quiet room the note is just audible, steady and clean, and it never seems to fade.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Compacting dilithium crystals for storage turned their individual tones into a single, pure note. I keep the block near tuning-sensitive machines and they seem to like it.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Precision Lithography.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dilithium Crystal, Dilithium Lamp.
